role_assignments_dates_order.name: role_assignments_dates_order
role_assignments_dates_order.value: "arche"."role_assignments"."to_on" is null or "arche"."role_assignments"."from_on" is null or "arche"."role_assignments"."to_on" >= "arche"."role_assignments"."from_on"

budget_lines_local_has_currency.name: budget_lines_local_has_currency
budget_lines_local_has_currency.value: "arche"."budget_lines"."amount_local" is null or "arche"."budget_lines"."currency" is not null

capex_lots_planned_order.name: capex_lots_planned_order
capex_lots_planned_order.value: "arche"."capex_lots"."planned_start" is null or "arche"."capex_lots"."planned_end" is null or "arche"."capex_lots"."planned_end" >= "arche"."capex_lots"."planned_start"

dossier_versions_frozen_hashed.name: dossier_versions_frozen_hashed
dossier_versions_frozen_hashed.value: "arche"."dossier_versions"."state" in ('draft', 'superseded') or ("arche"."dossier_versions"."content_hash" is not null and "arche"."dossier_versions"."frozen_at" is not null)

lot_actuals_local_has_currency.name: lot_actuals_local_has_currency
lot_actuals_local_has_currency.value: ("arche"."lot_actuals"."committed_local" is null and "arche"."lot_actuals"."spent_local" is null) or "arche"."lot_actuals"."currency" is not null

lot_forecasts_local_has_currency.name: lot_forecasts_local_has_currency
lot_forecasts_local_has_currency.value: "arche"."lot_forecasts"."amount_local" is null or "arche"."lot_forecasts"."currency" is not null
